name: criteria
title: CTCAE laboratory grading criteria (machine-readable transcription)
description: One row per CTCAE version x test x direction x baseline arm x grade x clause. Every row quotes the grade cell verbatim (WORDING) and the fragment it transcribes (CLAUSE). Rows with LAB_DERIVABLE = N document grade cells or clauses that cannot be derived from laboratory data and are never used to grade. A grade is reached when any of its lab-derivable clauses holds under the active profile; clauses with a QUALIFIER are switched on or off by the conventions and profile (see conventions.csv).

fields.name: RULE_ID
fields.description: Identifier referenced by records.csv RULE_IDS: V<version>.<LBTESTCD>.<H|L>.<ANY|NRM|ABN|BLL>.G<grade>; several clauses of one grade share the RULE_ID and differ in CLAUSE_SEQ

fields.name: CLAUSE_SEQ
fields.description: Sequence of the clause within the RULE_ID

fields.name: VERSION
fields.description: CTCAE major version

fields.name: LBTESTCD
fields.description: CDISC laboratory test code (analytes.csv)

fields.name: LBSPEC
fields.description: Specimen type of the graded test (CDISC SPECTYPE submission value)

fields.name: CTCAE_TERM
fields.description: Official CTCAE term of this version, as printed

fields.name: SOC
fields.description: MedDRA System Organ Class under which CTCAE lists the term

fields.name: DIRECTION
fields.description: Direction of the abnormality graded

fields.name: BASELINE_ARM
fields.description: Baseline condition under which the clause applies: ANY = unconditional; NORMAL = baseline not abnormal in the graded direction; ABNORMAL = baseline >ULN (HIGH) or <LLN (LOW); BELOW_LLN = baseline below LLN (v6 creatinine)

fields.name: GRADE
fields.description: CTCAE grade of the cell

fields.name: LAB_DERIVABLE
fields.description: Y = the clause can be evaluated from a laboratory value, its normal range and baseline; N = documentation only

fields.name: WORDING
fields.description: Verbatim text of the grade cell (whitespace normalised)

fields.name: CLAUSE
fields.description: Verbatim fragment of WORDING that this row transcribes; several non-contiguous fragments are joined with '; '

fields.name: COMPARATOR
fields.description: Comparison of OPERAND against THRESHOLD (blank for LAB_DERIVABLE = N)

fields.name: OPERAND
fields.description: VALUE = result in UNIT_SI; PCHG = (value - baseline) / baseline x 100; EXCESS_ULN = value - ULN; EXCESS_BASE_OR_ULN = value minus the baseline when the baseline is >ULN, otherwise value minus ULN

fields.name: THRESHOLD
fields.description: Number in THRESHOLD_UNIT, or a multiple of ULN, LLN or BASE (e.g. 3*ULN, 1.5*BASE, 0.25*LLN)

fields.name: THRESHOLD_UNIT
fields.description: Unit of a numeric THRESHOLD: the analyte UNIT_SI, or % for PCHG

fields.name: THRESHOLD_CONV
fields.description: The same bound as CTCAE prints it in conventional units (number in THRESHOLD_CONV_UNIT, or ULN/LLN); blank when CTCAE gives no conventional figure

fields.name: THRESHOLD_CONV_UNIT
fields.description: Unit of THRESHOLD_CONV (analyte UNIT_CONV)

fields.name: CONDITION
fields.description: Additional laboratory condition that must hold (AND): VALUE>BASE = the result exceeds the baseline

fields.name: QUALIFIER
fields.description: Clinical qualifier attached to the clause; conventions.csv states which qualifiers the default and alternative profiles assume

fields.name: CONVENTION
fields.description: Space-separated convention codes (conventions.csv) that govern how the clause is read

fields.name: SOURCE_DOC
fields.description: Document the wording was transcribed from

fields.name: SOURCE_PAGE
fields.description: Printed page number of the term in SOURCE_DOC

fields.name: NOTE
fields.description: Transcription note
